description_en: Sends a security daily report to a specified email address. Only security reports with a custom time period as the report cycle are supported
description_zh: 发送安全日报到指定邮箱。仅支持发送报告周期为自定义时间段的安全报告
name: SendCustomizeReport

parameters.help_en:
The report ID.
Call [DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~) to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
报告ID。
调用[DescribeCustomizeReportList](~~DescribeCustomizeReportList~~)可以获取该参数
parameters.name: report_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
